text:
maria_sales: Quick sync — Wed ramp at 09:00 PT, ~2k req/min for 30m. Need runbook + owners. Sara will send IPs.

aj_solutions: Noted. Blockers: intermittent 401s (token refresh), preprod 429s at high concurrency, and customer question on burst credits for Dedicated. Owners: devin SRE, nora SSQ/KMS, kevin pricing.

kevin_acctexec: Customer asks to waive overages first 24h. I can request a short courtesy waiver; legal needs to OK.

devin_sre: We reproduced 429s when instance_concurrency >80. Logs: 
[2025-09-01T14:12:04Z] WARN rate_limiter: tenant=acme rps=1200 con=96 queued=120 -> 429
[2025-09-01T14:12:05Z] ERROR serve: downstream timeout 10s
Mitigation: set per-instance max_concurrency=64 and enable per-tenant burst queue for 30m during ramp. I can apply before Wed.

aj_solutions: Fallback routing: if latency>800ms for 2m, split 80/20 to redwood-lite-4q. Will prepare patch.

sara_cust: ETA for concurrency change? Also where are KMS keys located for SOC2?

nora_security: SSQ updated at https://redwood.example/ssq/acme. Keys are customer-specific via KMS; HSM-backed CMKs supported in Private. I can extract cert snippets if needed. Need egress IPs for allowlist.

maria_sales: Runbook: devin primary, aj backup. Pre-warm 08:45 PT, standby 08:30-10:00 PT.

devin_sre: Runbook steps: pre-warm caches 08:45, apply relaxed per-tenant rate 08:50, monitor token errors, pause if persistent 429 >5m. Rollback in two 5m steps.

aj_solutions: Health checks: token refresh error rate, token_retry_rate, latency p50/p95. If token_refresh_error_rate >0.5% for 5m, switch to fallback model.

kevin_acctexec: I'll share MSA addendum draft tonight.

sara_cust: I'll send IP list and SOC contact by EOD. Need checklist for infra.

maria_sales: Customer infra checklist: egress IPs, outbound 443 to api.redwood.example, metrics port 9009 if scraping, TLS cert or mTLS status, service-account JWT issuer.

aj_solutions: Diagnostics to run if errors: grep logs for token errors, run a quick client profile with hey -c50 -q200 -z30s to /v1/generate.

devin_sre: If 503s appear check /var/log/infer.log for OOM/cuda and watch node_cpu/gpu_mem_used.

deploy-bot: deploy: config `trial-ramp-2025` applied by aj_solutions at 2025-09-02T02:03:00Z :white_check_mark:

sara_cust: Confirmed — will share IPs and SOC contact. Thanks for runbook. :thumbsup:

maria_sales: I'll ping channel 08:20 PT for 15m pre-ramp sync. Thanks everyone.
